name: Tollkeeper's Receipt
quirk: Every kill drops 3 extra gold, but each swing that misses deducts 2 gold from your pouch.
lore: Recovered from the burned toll house at the Sunken Ford. Collector Harlon kept his books balanced in ink until the highland raiders arrived, and in marrow thereafter.

name: Bren's Only Dry Boot
quirk: Grants +25% movement speed in water or mud, but leaves a loud squelching trail that increases enemy aggro range by 3 tiles.
lore: Scout Bren swore he lost its twin in the willow sinks east of Ravenwatch. In truth, he traded it to a bog hermit for three dry biscuits and a map that was mostly lies.

name: Candle of the Sunken Sanctum
quirk: Fire spells deal +20% damage, but standing in water extinguishes the wand for 6 s, reducing spell damage by 15%.
lore: Carved from bleached alder wood and dipped in rendered tallow from the Ravenwatch crypts. Mordred the Ashen used it to light rituals where dry kindling refused to catch.

name: Splinter of the Bailey
quirk: Blocks 40% of ranged projectile damage, but burns for double duration when hit by fire.
lore: A three-inch slab of seasoned iron-oak pried from the shattered inner portcullis of Ravenwatch Keep. Three broken iron arrowheads are still wedged in the grain.

name: Tax-Collector's Recurve
quirk: Every 4th arrow pins the target's shadow to the dirt, rooting them for 2.5 s.
lore: Quartermaster Tarn confiscated forty such bows from Greywood poachers before the war. When the border collapsed, he handed them back with instructions to shoot anything wearing furs.

name: Quarryman's Grievance
quirk: Hits against armored or stone targets deal +35% crushing damage and reduce their armor by 2 for 5 s.
lore: Bound with quarry-chain and weighted with a chunk of enchanted granite chipped from Krag Ironhide's left knee. It is unsubtle, poorly balanced, and thoroughly persuasive.

name: Seal of Unread Dispatches
quirk: While below 35% HP, your movement speed increases by 30%, but you cannot cast offensive spells.
lore: Courier Corin swallowed this signet ring twice during the siege of Lantern Passage to keep it from the Ravine Warden. He politely declined to wear it again afterward.

name: Miner's Canary Cage
quirk: Emits a loud metallic chirping whenever poison clouds are within 6 tiles, granting +15% accuracy to nearby allies.
lore: Worn by the deep-sappers who cleared the Undervault Links. There is no bird inside the iron crest anymore—only a bound marsh-wisp that shrieks when the air turns sour.

name: Widow's Loom-Weight
quirk: When struck in melee, weaves a brittle silk thread that slows the attacker by 30% for 4 s.
lore: Cut from the calcified silk-gland of Morvessa beneath the Weeping Ossuary. It remains unpleasantly sticky in humid weather and attracts cellar spiders.

name: Deserter's Tin Canteen
quirk: Drinking a Healing Draught also restores 25 mana, but inflicts a 3 s coughing fit that reduces accuracy by 4.
lore: Half-full of Redmarsh brackish water and cheap apricot spirit. It tastes of rust and dead beetles, yet men have killed their brothers at Highgate Watch for a single swallow.

name: Saelen's Marrow-Needle
quirk: Every critical hit steals 8 mana from the target and infects them with 4 poison damage per second for 6 s.
lore: Hexer Saelen maintained that bloodletting cured all frontier complaints, particularly the complaint of imperial soldiers standing upright in his desert.

name: Indenture Breaker
quirk: Every 4th hit releases a shockwave of ironstone dust that blinds enemies in a 2-tile radius for 3 s.
lore: Wielded by the head convict of the Deep Quarry during the terrace uprising. The iron chain wrapping the haft is still stamped with his prison serial number.

name: Splinter of the Third Monolith
quirk: Casting an Air or Earth spell discharges a static arc to the nearest foe within 5 tiles for 18 lightning damage.
lore: Chipped from the northern wardstone during the great dust-rupture. It smells permanently of scorched sand and makes the bearer's hair stand on end before rain.

name: Iron Wheel of Wagon Four
quirk: Reduces movement speed by 8%, but makes the bearer completely immune to knockback and stun effects.
lore: When the fourth munitions wagon broke its axle in the Redmarsh mire, Quartermaster Bram bolted a leather strap to the iron-rimmed wheel and told his sergeant to stop complaining.

name: Spurs of Tactical Withdrawal
quirk: Moving away from enemies grants +20% speed and +4 mana regen, but moving toward them reduces your armor by 2.
lore: Taken from Commander Vorn's baggage train in Spearwind Gorge. His officers called it a rout; his memoirs, left unfinished in the saddlebag, called it 'an aggressive rearward realignment.'

name: pitch-steeped Winding Sheet
quirk: Grants +100% resistance to poison and disease, but increases all fire damage taken by 35%.
lore: Unwound from a three-century-old magistrate in the salt tombs below Redmarsh. The bitumen preservative keeps out marsh-rot wonderfully, provided one stays far from open torches.

name: Salt-Mirage Longbow
quirk: Arrows fired from more than 6 tiles away split into a shimmering heat-haze, hitting a second target for 50% damage.
lore: Laminated from dried dune-beast horn and sinew cured in alkaline brine. Looking along the arrow-shelf for too long induces a mild, pleasant hallucination of cold beer.

name: Bezoar of the Sand Glutton
quirk: Absorbs the first 15 points of damage from any poison or acid attack and converts it into 10 HP.
lore: Hacked from the third stomach of Gorrathul alongside six rusted belt buckles, a brass astrolabe, and the guild-signet of a missing spice caravan.

name: Healer Sera's Amputation Saw
quirk: Critical hits inflict a bleeding wound for 8 damage/s over 5 s and heal the nearest injured ally for 20 HP.
lore: 'Hold him down and give him the leather strap to bite. If he dies of shock, at least he won't die of gangrene.' — Chief Healer Sera, during the third night at the woodland infirmary.

name: Barnacle-Crusted Brigandine
quirk: Attackers striking you in melee take 9 physical thorn damage from the razor-sharp sea barnacles.
lore: Worn by the Sunken Citadel's castellan, who refused to abandon the lower guardroom even after the winter tides permanently claimed the ground floor.

name: The Baron's Cooking-Ledger Ring
quirk: Shop prices in towns are reduced by 15%, but enemies focus their attacks on you first as if you owed them back-pay.
lore: The rogue baron of Oakhaven kept two signet rings: one for signing imperial tax charters, and this one for transferring garrison pension funds into his private catacombs.

name: Turnkey of the North Gate
quirk: Fires heavy iron bolts that pierce through the first target to hit a second foe behind them for 75% damage.
lore: When Gate Warden Lyra ran out of standard cedar quarrels during the Hourglass siege, her engineers began loading iron door-hinges and broken jail keys into the windlass.

name: Sluice-Master's Wrench
quirk: Every 5th hit knocks the target backward 2 tiles and stuns them for 2 s.
lore: Fourteen pounds of drop-forged Oakhaven iron designed to turn the rusted floodgate gears of Riverlock Crossing. It turns helmets with equal mechanical leverage.

name: Lightning-Split Bough
quirk: Chain Lightning and Thunderstorm jump to 2 additional targets, but each cast shocks the wielder for 6 HP.
lore: Harvested from the charred heartwood of the coastal Stormtree. The wood never truly stopped burning; it merely agreed to wait until pointed at someone else.

name: Harbor-Burner's Astrolabe
quirk: Increases the reach of all ranged spells by +2 tiles.
lore: Taken from Admiral Kael's charred cabin aboard his flagship in Harborwatch. The brass lenses are cracked by heat, yet they still calculate artillery trajectories with cruel precision.

name: Clapper of the Submerged Nave
quirk: Whenever your mana drops below 20%, emits a freezing chime that slows all foes within 4 tiles for 4 s (30 s cooldown).
lore: A salt-eaten bronze pendulum salvaged from the flooded bell-tower of the Sunken Citadel. Even on dry land, it swings slightly in rhythm with the coastal tide.

name: Hollow Reed of Vesperion
quirk: Spells drain 5 mana from every enemy hit and restore it to the caster.
lore: One of the smaller bone pipes from Vesperion's dorsal cathedral organ. When swung through the air, it produces a flat, liturgical F-sharp that makes dogs weep.

name: Malrik's Margin-Notes
quirk: Reduces all spell cooldowns by 20%, but 15% of all damage taken is subtracted from your Mana before HP.
lore: Bound in the fire-cured hide of a highland drake. Arch-Mage Malrik's handwriting begins in neat academic script and degenerates over three hundred pages into frantic geometric diagrams.

name: Dent of Greystone Wall
quirk: Reduces damage from area-of-effect explosions and boulders by 45%.
lore: Captain Rowan took a glancing blow from a basalt catapult stone on the third day at Greystone Bastion. His neck was never straight again, which he claimed improved his posture on parade.

name: Tongs of the Cinderforge
quirk: Every 3rd hit brands the target with white-hot slag, dealing 15 fire damage/s for 4 s and melting 3 armor.
lore: Still glowing dull cherry-red at the core. If left on a wooden table in Ironcamp, it burns its way through to the floorboards before the ale goes flat.

name: Caldera Glass Greatbow
quirk: Arrows shatter into volcanic glass on impact, dealing 30% of their damage in a 2-tile cone behind the target.
lore: Ribbed with flexible strips of crimson obsidian taken from a Redglass Drake's wing-spar. Drawing the string without heavy leather gauntlets is a quick way to lose three fingers.

name: Portcullis of the First Checkpoint
quirk: While standing completely still, you gain +5 armor and reflect 25% of ranged damage back at the shooter.
lore: Carried through the Gauntlet of Iron by a vanguard sergeant who died standing upright, wedged so tightly between two basalt boulders that the enemy had to climb over him.

name: Coal-Walker's Sabatons
quirk: Leaves a trail of burning embers as you walk that deals 10 fire damage/s to pursuing enemies, but burns you for 2 HP/s while standing still.
lore: Forged without leather linings so they would never catch fire in the lava trenches of the Outer Rampart. The soldiers who wore them learned never to stop marching.

name: Abdication
quirk: Deals +25% damage to bosses and elite monsters, and executes non-boss enemies below 12% HP instantly.
lore: An ancient coronation greatsword whose royal crest was chiseled off with a cold iron punch. It weighs as much as a wet sack of salt and cuts like a broken treaty.

name: Signet of the Two Paths
quirk: When HP is above 50%, grants +15% spell damage; when HP is below 50%, grants +15% physical damage and +8% lifesteal.
lore: Found upon the stone threshold before the Crown Vault. One half of the bezel is set with cold celestial silver, the other with slag from the Obsidian Throne.

name: Cinder-King's Halberd-Horn
quirk: Every 5th spell or weapon attack unleashes a ring of volcanic fire around you for 38 fire damage.
lore: A molten iron sword-tip broken from the blazing halo above Ashkarath's brow. Even suspended on a heavy chain, it pulls slightly toward the center of the earth.
